svg.title: 5 November 2026 — JavaScript objects wrap-up
svg.desc: Six lesson panels: preventExtensions, destructuring, property descriptors, own property inspection, object identity, and Object.assign. Based on WrapUpObjects.js, commit 10bd961.
svg.text: Control properties, extract values, inspect behavior, and combine data.
Returns the same object; new own properties are blocked.
Existing properties still follow their own descriptor rules.
name: empName renames the local variable.
Defaults apply to missing / undefined values, not null.
writable → can the data value be assigned?
configurable → deletable; permits most descriptor edits
For a new descriptor, omitted flags default to false.
These two methods list own string keys; symbols are excluded.
=== asks whether both references identify the same object
const a = {}; const same = a; const b = {};
Equal-looking contents do not make objects identical.
Same key? The last source value wins.
Copies own enumerable values (string and symbol keys).
Shallow copy: nested objects remain shared references.
This project uses ES modules. Adding blocked properties, writing read-only values,
or deleting non-configurable properties throws TypeError.
SESSION EVIDENCE november5th2026/WrapUpObjects.js • commit 10bd961 • examples executed with Node.js
VERIFIED WITH MDN preventExtensions · Destructuring · defineProperties · hasOwn · getOwnPropertyNames · assign
